name: masscon-fluid
description: Browser GPU reimplementation of Chentanez & Mueller, Mass-Conserving Eulerian Liquid Simulation (SCA 2012)

scripts.test: node tools/interact.mjs 2d && node tools/interact.mjs 3d && node tools/interact.mjs world
scripts.test:firefox: node tools/interact.mjs 2d --browser firefox && node tools/interact.mjs 3d --browser firefox && node tools/interact.mjs world --browser firefox
scripts.test:librewolf: node tools/interact.mjs 2d --browser librewolf && node tools/interact.mjs 3d --browser librewolf && node tools/interact.mjs world --browser librewolf
